title: Add ContextEpoch and stable baseline context
acceptance: Provider turns reference context_epoch_id; baseline hash stable across volatile date/git/file-list changes; compaction/model/provider switches create explicit epoch outcomes.

title: Add provider-neutral prompt cache policy plus provider adapters
acceptance: Cache support states distinguish automatic, explicit, implicit, unsupported, unknown, not reported, and disabled; adapter fixtures cover OpenAI, Anthropic/Bedrock/Vertex, Gemini, Alibaba/Qwen, and OpenCode bridge evidence.

title: Normalize cache usage/read/write metrics
acceptance: Usage records expose cached_input_tokens/cache_write/cache_read/cache_reporting_state/cache_miss_reason; UI does not show zero cache as unsupported or vice versa.

title: Separate volatile context from cacheable baseline
acceptance: Date/workspace root/git flag/file-list/active pane changes do not mutate baseline prompt; they enter metadata or mid-conversation update at safe boundary.

title: Prevent streaming partials from becoming durable duplicate history
acceptance: Cumulative snapshots are persisted once; missing terminal event is retryable error; zero-usage aborted turn is not model replay content.

title: Define transport policy for WebSocket/SSE/stdout/unix-socket/HTTP
acceptance: Transport decision receipts include locality, auth, replay, backpressure, fallback, and provider support; OpenCode remains HTTP/SSE unless upstream contract changes.

title: Add WebSocket origin/auth/CSRF/runtime-id security gates
acceptance: Remote/tunnel WS requires configured auth; wrong Origin/CSRF/runtime id is rejected before initialize; security receipts are visible and redacted.

title: Add lazy/searchable MCP/tool/skill catalog cache with result-path parity
acceptance: Large MCP catalogs stay under context budget; lazy-selected rich outputs normalize identically to eager invocation; descriptor cache is provider/model/plugin scoped.

title: Make compaction cache impact explicit
acceptance: Compaction starts/continues epoch per rule; UI and usage explain cache lineage effect; manual compact does not mint lineage without logical context change.

title: Extend provider capability epoch with cache/freshness/source metadata
acceptance: Model metadata source/freshness/account/route-limit/cache support are recorded; stale/ghost model or route-specific limit changes produce explicit capability epoch.

title: Sanitize provider-native reasoning/item/cache metadata on model switch
acceptance: Provider-native reasoning signatures/item ids/cache keys/tool histories are retained only when compatible; otherwise dropped with replay receipt.

title: Apply context caps to utility/memory/subagent models
acceptance: Local utility/memory/subagent contexts enforce model caps and bounded summaries; no hidden full-history stuffing.

title: Add bounded queues, overload, retry, and pressure diagnostics
acceptance: Frame ingress queues bounded; overflow returns structured overload; UI distinguishes provider stall, WS reconnect, backend stall, and UI render lag.

title: Separate PTY bytes, terminal parser state, scrollback, and model-visible excerpts
acceptance: Terminal byte stream preserves parser state across chunks; scrollback is not model context; WebSocket, if used, is UI transport not terminal engine.

title: Add cache observability dashboard and rollups
acceptance: Per-provider/model/account cache hit/miss/cost savings views expose measured vs estimated vs unsupported states.

title: Hash-addressed cache refs for stable large tool outputs
acceptance: Large stable outputs use refs with TTL/redaction; secrets are never cached; model-visible preview references complete retained output.

title: Add WS/SSE/terminal/browser/device transport soak tests
acceptance: Sleep/wake, reconnect, first-event timeout, large terminal output, high-frequency browser snapshots, and WebSocket fallback are covered.

title: Expose provider cache retention/privacy boundaries
acceptance: Cache retention policy and org/account boundary shown when available; no unsupported manual cache clearing is promised.
